ElementSets, BoundaryMatrices, UnsignedBoundaryMatrices, NonZeros, IndicatorVector from MeshConnectivity

M : CellMesh

V, E, F, C = ElementSets( M )
`∂⁰`, `∂¹`, `∂²` = BoundaryMatrices(M) 
`B⁰`, `B¹`, `B²` = UnsignedBoundaryMatrices(M)
`B⁰ᵀ` = `B⁰`ᵀ
`B¹ᵀ` = `B¹`ᵀ
`B²ᵀ` = `B²`ᵀ

Vertices(S) = S₁ where S: CellularSet
Edges(S)    = S₂ where S: CellularSet 
Faces(S)    = S₃ where S: CellularSet
Cells(S)    = S₄ where S: CellularSet
 
Vertices(f) = vertexset(NonZeros(`B⁰` (`B¹` IndicatorVector({f})))) where f ∈ F
Vertices(G) = vertexset(NonZeros(`B⁰` (`B¹` IndicatorVector(G)))) where G ⊂ F
Vertices(t) = vertexset(NonZeros(`B⁰` (`B¹` (`B²` IndicatorVector({t}))))) where t ∈ C
Vertices(J) = vertexset(NonZeros(`B⁰` (`B¹` (`B²` IndicatorVector(J))))) where J ⊂ C
Vertices(e) = vertexset(NonZeros(`B⁰` IndicatorVector({e}))) where e ∈ E
Vertices(H) = vertexset(NonZeros(`B⁰` IndicatorVector(H))) where H ⊂ E
 
Edges(v) = edgeset(NonZeros(`B⁰ᵀ` IndicatorVector({v}))) where v ∈ V
Edges(f) = edgeset(NonZeros(`B¹` IndicatorVector({f}))) where f ∈ F
Edges(t) = edgeset(NonZeros(`B¹` (`B²` IndicatorVector({t})))) where t ∈ C

Faces(v) = faceset(NonZeros(`B¹ᵀ` (`B⁰ᵀ` IndicatorVector({v})))) where v ∈ V
Faces(e) = faceset(NonZeros(`B¹ᵀ` IndicatorVector({e}))) where e ∈ E
Faces(t) = faceset(NonZeros(`B²` IndicatorVector({t}))) where t ∈ C

"""
ElementSets, BoundaryMatrices, UnsignedBoundaryMatrices, NonZeros, IndicatorVector from MeshConnectivity

M : CellMesh

V, E, F, C = ElementSets( M )
`∂⁰`, `∂¹`, `∂²` = BoundaryMatrices(M) 
`B⁰`, `B¹`, `B²` = UnsignedBoundaryMatrices(M)
`B⁰ᵀ` = `B⁰`ᵀ
`B¹ᵀ` = `B¹`ᵀ
`B²ᵀ` = `B²`ᵀ

Vertices(S) = S₁ where S: CellularSet
Edges(S)    = S₂ where S: CellularSet 
Faces(S)    = S₃ where S: CellularSet
Cells(S)    = S₄ where S: CellularSet
 
Vertices(f) = vertexset(NonZeros(`B⁰` (`B¹` IndicatorVector({f})))) where f ∈ F
Vertices(G) = vertexset(NonZeros(`B⁰` (`B¹` IndicatorVector(G)))) where G ⊂ F
Vertices(t) = vertexset(NonZeros(`B⁰` (`B¹` (`B²` IndicatorVector({t}))))) where t ∈ C
Vertices(J) = vertexset(NonZeros(`B⁰` (`B¹` (`B²` IndicatorVector(J))))) where J ⊂ C
Vertices(e) = vertexset(NonZeros(`B⁰` IndicatorVector({e}))) where e ∈ E
Vertices(H) = vertexset(NonZeros(`B⁰` IndicatorVector(H))) where H ⊂ E
 
Edges(v) = edgeset(NonZeros(`B⁰ᵀ` IndicatorVector({v}))) where v ∈ V
Edges(f) = edgeset(NonZeros(`B¹` IndicatorVector({f}))) where f ∈ F
Edges(t) = edgeset(NonZeros(`B¹` (`B²` IndicatorVector({t})))) where t ∈ C

Faces(v) = faceset(NonZeros(`B¹ᵀ` (`B⁰ᵀ` IndicatorVector({v})))) where v ∈ V
Faces(e) = faceset(NonZeros(`B¹ᵀ` IndicatorVector({e}))) where e ∈ E
Faces(t) = faceset(NonZeros(`B²` IndicatorVector({t}))) where t ∈ C
"""
import numpy as np
import scipy
import scipy.linalg
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.integrate import quad, solve_ivp
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from triangle_mesh import *


class heartlib:
    def __init__(self, M):
        rhs = M.ElementSets()
        self.V = rhs[0]
        self.E = rhs[1]
        self.F = rhs[2]
        self.C = rhs[3]
        dimv_0 = M.n_vertices()
        dime_0 = M.n_edges()
        dimf_0 = M.n_faces()

        self.M = M
        rhs_1 = M.BoundaryMatrices()
        self.dee0 = rhs_1[0]
        self.dee1 = rhs_1[1]
        self.dee2 = rhs_1[2]
        rhs_2 = M.UnsignedBoundaryMatrices()
        self.B0 = rhs_2[0]
        self.B1 = rhs_2[1]
        self.B2 = rhs_2[2]
        # `B⁰ᵀ` = `B⁰`ᵀ
        self.B0T = self.B0.T
        # `B¹ᵀ` = `B¹`ᵀ
        self.B1T = self.B1.T
        # `B²ᵀ` = `B²`ᵀ
        self.B2T = self.B2.T

    def Vertices(self, S):
        return S[1-1]

    def Edges(self, S):
        return S[2-1]

    def Faces(self, S):
        return S[3-1]

    def Cells(self, S):
        return S[4-1]

    def Vertices_0(self, f):
        assert np.ndim(f) == 0
        assert f in self.F

        return nonzeros(self.B0 @ (self.B1 @ indicator({f}, self.M.n_faces())))

    def Vertices_1(self, G):
        G = frozenset(G)
        return nonzeros(self.B0 @ (self.B1 @ indicator(G, self.M.n_faces())))

    def Vertices_2(self, t):
        assert np.ndim(t) == 0
        assert t in self.C

        return nonzeros(self.B0 @ (self.B1 @ (self.B2 @ indicator({t}, self.M.n_tets()))))

    def Vertices_3(self, J):
        J = frozenset(J)
        return nonzeros(self.B0 @ (self.B1 @ (self.B2 @ indicator(J, self.M.n_tets()))))

    def Vertices_4(self, e):
        assert np.ndim(e) == 0
        assert e in self.E

        return nonzeros(self.B0 @ indicator({e}, self.M.n_edges()))

    def Vertices_5(self, H):
        H = frozenset(H)
        return nonzeros(self.B0 @ indicator(H, self.M.n_edges()))

    def Edges_0(self, v):
        assert np.ndim(v) == 0
        assert v in self.V

        return nonzeros(self.B0T @ indicator({v}, self.M.n_vertices()))

    def Edges_1(self, f):
        assert np.ndim(f) == 0
        assert f in self.F

        return nonzeros(self.B1 @ indicator({f}, self.M.n_faces()))

    def Edges_2(self, t):
        assert np.ndim(t) == 0
        assert t in self.C

        return nonzeros(self.B1 @ (self.B2 @ indicator({t}, self.M.n_tets())))

    def Faces_0(self, v):
        assert np.ndim(v) == 0
        assert v in self.V

        return nonzeros(self.B1T @ (self.B0T @ indicator({v}, self.M.n_vertices())))

    def Faces_1(self, e):
        assert np.ndim(e) == 0
        assert e in self.E

        return nonzeros(self.B1T @ indicator({e}, self.M.n_edges()))

    def Faces_2(self, t):
        assert np.ndim(t) == 0
        assert t in self.C

        return nonzeros(self.B2 @ indicator({t}, self.M.n_tets()))
